title: Similar Pest Differential Entry
description: Schema for a record describing how to distinguish two similar-looking or similar-damaging pests.

pest_id.description: The pest being compared (reference to pest_ontology.json).

similar_to.description: The pest it resembles (reference to pest_ontology.json).

scope.description: The aspect under which they are similar.

feature.description: The feature being compared (e.g. 'wing pattern', 'body size').

reliability.description: How reliably this feature distinguishes the two pests.

confidence_notes.description: Overall confidence in distinguishing these two pests, including caveats.
